dataset.data_nature: SYNTHETIC - produced by the in-repo IMPES simulator; no field data, no field validation

case_selection.finer_subset_rule: cases with at most 12000 production time steps, spread by permeability

monte_carlo_prior.convention: 5-Uncertainty.pdf p.46: P10 = value exceeded by 10% of estimates

model_bias_unmodelled_physics_not_quanti: gravity / buoyant override (1-D radial layers, no vertical flow)
CO2 dissolution in brine and the two-shock structure (4-CO2 BL.pdf p.25-29)
error_sources.caveat: Input uncertainty is the spread of an ASSUMED prior, not uncertainty constrained by measurements. Model bias from omitted physics is listed, not quantified.
error_sources.numerical_error_source: dataset cases re-simulated with every discretisation refined (median of 41 cases; max 0.54 %)

uncertainty.prior_note: Monte Carlo over the ASSUMED prior (development reservoirs); P10/P90 follow 5-Uncertainty.pdf p.46

speed.hardware_note: same machine, same process, 1 scenario at a time for the simulator; scikit-learn/XGBoost default threading
speed.outputs_compared: the three scalar QoIs; the end-to-end time includes building the inputs and the analytical ROM; the simulator also yields fields and time series

interpretation.disclaimer: Permutation importance, SHAP and local explanations describe how the fitted model uses its inputs; they are not causal effects.

reservoir_pca.note: the reservoir inputs are sampled independently, so PCA finds little shared structure -- a property of the synthetic design

studies.units_of_all_rmse_values: RMSE of ln(target / ROM), the learned correction

conservation_check.conclusion: Under the sealed boundary retained mass equals the planned injected mass (CO2 mass balance), so it is computed exactly and is not an ML target.

screening.limit_status: stated modelling assumptions, not fracture or caprock criteria
